SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-22' AND DATE '2026-09-28' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dim' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) m, min(join_date) mn, max(join_date) mx, max(valid_from) mxv FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), min(join_date), max(join_date), max(valid_from) FROM stg_member_updates

SELECT 'stg_25sep' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) m, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) key_in_dim, sum(CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) id_in_dim FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date='2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_25sep_ids_with_other_join', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), 0,0 FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25') AND join_date<>'2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_25sep_ids_multi_versions', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), 0,0 FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25')
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_25sep_valid_from_ne_join', count(*),0,0,0 FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25' AND valid_from<>join_date
